title: Velmar
line: The online store and back office of a workshop that makes personalized goods, in an end-to-end clickable demo.

facts.v: A real workshop in Mar del Plata

film.alt: Velmar panel with fictional data: indicators, the order funnel and the production queue by stage.
film.label: Demo · sample data

ten.v: Every order starts in a chat, goes into a spreadsheet and onto a phone calendar; stock and delivery dates, by hand.
A mobile store where buyers see their product before paying, and a panel that takes each order from the receipt to delivery.
A navigable demo on sample data, made so the workshop sees its business working before the project starts.

how.d: The buyer builds a collar; the preview and the price change live.
Adding to the cart approves the design, which travels with the order to the workshop.
A receipt puts the order under review until the workshop approves it.
The production queue moves it through machine and finishing, and deducts supplies.
The calendar offers the first date with room, based on the workshop's capacity.

decisions.why: A static export to show it before starting; production adds a server, Prisma and login, and the components are reused.
Prices, coupons, states, dates and draws live in pure functions with injectable randomness: tested on their own, ready to move server-side.
Tables edit like a spreadsheet, with keyboard, ranges, copy and paste and undo, and import and export Excel or CSV.

collar-en-vivo.alt: Name-collar product page on a phone: ROCCO is typed in and the illustrated preview shows the hanging letters.
collar-en-vivo.caption: The configurator writes the name on the preview.

club-ruleta.alt: Full-screen green-and-gold "Girá y ganá" wheel: the centre is tapped, it spins and shows "¡Ganaste! Envío gratis".
club-ruleta.caption: Velmar club: the coupon wheel spins and gives a prize.

cupones.alt: "Mis cupones" screen with sample coupons (10% on the first purchase, free shipping with an account), each with its code.
cupones.caption: My coupons: sample coupons applied to the cart.

panel-calendario.alt: Monthly delivery calendar with orders per day, full days and holidays marked, plus counters for deliveries, late orders and capacity.
panel-calendario.caption: Delivery calendar with daily capacity.

more.p: Every incentive ends as a coupon in "Mis cupones": the cart validates everything with one rule and the panel controls each source. The wheel is a weighted draw in a pure function; prizes are single-use and expire.

Order states are a state machine with rules: the panel offers only valid transitions, in bulk too. Approving a receipt asks for confirmation; rejecting one asks for a reason. Each change leaves an email in a simulated outbox.
CI runs lint, types, unit tests, build, an export check and e2e on an emulated Pixel 7. Planned for production: a Next server, PostgreSQL with Prisma, role-based login and Mercado Pago.

next: Next step: checking on a real iPhone and iPad and confirming the collar styles.
